name: fz553_leech_seed_heal_block
purpose: Leech Seed under Heal Block: at step 1 the seeder (p2a) seeds p1a, and p1a's Psychic Noise gives the seeder Heal Block. In the residual the seeded Pokemon loses its HP, but this.heal for the seeder runs TryHeal, and Heal Block's onTryHeal returns false (data/moves.ts:8324-8333): no heal. On main the engine healed the seeder (issue 553, fz_422_53). Synthetic teams; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
